'''Vigilant X2-series picket droids''' were a fourth-degree [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model developed by [[Automata Galactica/Legends|Automata Galactica]] during the [[Old Republic era]].

They were created to defend checkpoints, guard headquarters, and protect strategic locations. These droids were similar to mobile weapons platforms, with a tough chassis, and heavy armament.

2X picket droids earned their moniker of "vigilant" due to their guard programming. A 2X droid would never leave its post without direct orders otherwise, and their backup power generator allowed it to outwait and outshoot most hostile forces.

==Characteristics==
X2 Droids where medium sized Tracked droids with a self-destruct feature meant to destroy resources that would otherwise be taken with their deactivation. They were capable of communicating through both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] and [[Binary/Legends|binary]], and attempt to warn sentients away from their posts to avoid unnecessary casualties.
